name: Trailhead
tagline: Every climb starts with the same problem: you can't carry everything. Learn to choose.
unitIntro: Unit 1: Trailhead. Every climb starts with the same problem: you can't carry everything. Learn to choose.
description: Pack your bag, read the map, and learn the one rule that runs every economy on Earth: there's never enough of everything.

name: Market Meadow
tagline: Out in the open, buyers and sellers meet. Watch how prices find their own level.
unitIntro: Unit 2: Market Meadow. Out in the open, buyers and sellers meet. Watch how prices find their own level.
description: Demand, supply, and the price where they meet. Why concert tickets sell out and why gas prices jump before a holiday.

name: Timber Camp
tagline: This is where the work gets done. Businesses, competition, and the paycheck with your name on it.
unitIntro: Unit 3: Timber Camp. This is where the work gets done. Businesses, competition, and the paycheck with your name on it.
description: How businesses compete, how entrepreneurs start them, and what decides how much your job pays.

name: River Crossing
tagline: Money flows like a river. Learn where it comes from, where it goes, and how to keep your footing.
unitIntro: Unit 4: River Crossing. Money flows like a river. Learn where it comes from, where it goes, and how to keep your footing.
description: What money really is, how banks work, your first checking account, and how stocks and bonds help money grow.

name: Switchbacks
tagline: The steep part. Slow, smart steps now keep you from sliding backward later.
unitIntro: Unit 5: Switchbacks. The steep part. Slow, smart steps now keep you from sliding backward later.
description: Budgets, smart shopping, college costs, credit scores, and insurance. The money skills you'll use the rest of your life.

name: The Ridge
tagline: Up here you can see the whole valley. Time to measure the entire economy at once.
unitIntro: Unit 6: The Ridge. Up here you can see the whole valley. Time to measure the entire economy at once.
description: GDP, jobs, inflation, and the boom-and-bust ride called the business cycle.

name: Ranger Station
tagline: Somebody maintains the trails. Here's who pays for it, and who steers when the weather turns.
unitIntro: Unit 7: Ranger Station. Somebody maintains the trails. Here's who pays for it, and who steers when the weather turns.
description: Taxes, government spending, the national debt, and the Federal Reserve.

name: The Summit
tagline: From the top you can see other mountains. Every country is connected to every other.
unitIntro: Unit 8: The Summit. From the top you can see other mountains. Every country is connected to every other.
description: Why countries trade, tariffs and exchange rates, and how Idaho fits into the global economy.
